name: Coupler.io
description: Analyze multi-channel marketing, financial, sales, e-commerce, and other business data within Claude by connecting to your Coupler.io data flows — query marketing, sales, and finance metrics from hundreds of sources. Fetch and transform raw data from platforms like Google Ads, Facebook, HubSpot, and Salesforce into actionable intelligence for smarter, faster decision-making with accurate, up-to-date business information.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coupler.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coupler.io to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.coupler.io/mcp/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coupler.io MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coupler.io provides these MCP tools: get-data, get-schema, list-dataflows, and get-dataflow.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coupler.io?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coupler.io in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Coupler.io requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coupler.io is developed by Coupler.io. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
